description: This PHP class `EmbeddedURLForYoutube` extends `AbstractBuzzVideoURL` and provides functionality to extract embedded YouTube URLs from various YouTube URL formats. It identifies whether a URL is a valid YouTube URL, and converts standard YouTube links into embedded URLs for use in embeddings or APIs.

classes.name: EmbeddedURLForYoutube
classes.description: A class for processing YouTube URLs to extract or generate embedded URL formats.

methods.name: getEmbeddedURL
methods.description: Returns the embedded URL for YouTube videos if the provided URL matches certain patterns; throws exception otherwise.
